<assessment>SOURCE is one street-level oblique view: a right-hand tower steps down toward a connected low wing and left block, with pale projecting grids, recessed glazing, scattered open planted bays, flat roof edges and darker lower facade components. CURRENT 10–12 retain these principal volume relationships and show convincing depth in the completed tower recesses. The clearest remaining mismatch is the broad charcoal structural framing across the left block and connector. Rear elevations, roof interiors and concealed slab-wall joints are not established by SOURCE; the supplied views do not prove hidden connection quality. Neighbor and external-context requirements remain contradictory and unresolved; their absence does not justify restoration or resolve the earlier requirements.</assessment>
<issue priority="1" view="front">problem: CURRENT 10 and 12 show heavy charcoal primary columns and beams across the left block and connector, interrupting SOURCE’s pale projecting grid. SOURCE’s darker lower facade components sit within that grid.
action: Locally correct the affected primary frame members to the pale structural finish. Preserve recessed dark components, glazing subdivisions, completed tower recesses and connected terrace geometry.</issue>
<keep>Existing pale tower beam-and-column members surrounding the completed recesses.
Completed tower recess side returns and overhead surfaces visible in CURRENT 11.
Connected planted outdoor pockets above the low wing visible in CURRENT 12.</keep>
